**Company Overview**

  

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

  

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please [click here](https://www.shrinerschildrens.org/en/locations?listPage=1) to learn more about our locations.

  

**CURRENT EMPLOYEES**: Please log into Workday [Click Here](https://identity.wd12.myworkday.com/wday/authgwy/shrinerschildrens/upc/login) to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"

  

**Job Description**

  

The Service Desk Analyst II serves as a senior member of the Information Services Service Desk and provides first-line technical support for software applications, hardware, and information systems utilized throughout the organization. This position acts as a backup to the Department Manager and assists with the daily operations of the Service Desk, including staffing coordination, scheduling, work assignments, quality monitoring, and team development.

  

The Service Desk Analyst II is responsible for responding to user inquiries, troubleshooting software and hardware issues, managing incident resolution, developing end-user documentation, and training materials, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. This role collaborates closely with Information Services teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve technical issues and improve service delivery. The position requires strong Service Desk experience, technical troubleshooting skills, leadership abilities, and knowledge of enterprise applications, preferably within a healthcare environment.

  

There are two openings for the Service Desk Analyst II position. The weekly schedule for each of these two openings is:

- 3PM - 12AM Midnight ET Monday through Friday
- 3PM - 12AM Midnight ET Saturday through Wednesday

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Serve as a senior resource for the Service Desk and provide backup support to the Department Manager.
- Assist the Supervisor with daily Service Desk operations, including staffing, scheduling, workload distribution, queue management, and support coverage.
- Monitor and resolve Service Desk incidents and service requests while ensuring compliance with service level expectations.
- Review and audit incidents and service requests for quality, accuracy, documentation standards, and customer service excellence.
- Mentor, coach, and train Service Desk personnel to strengthen technical knowledge, service delivery, and troubleshooting capabilities.
- Provide ongoing guidance to Service Desk staff regarding best practices, processes, and procedures.
- Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend enhancements to Service Desk operations and customer experience.
- Provide first-line support for all organizational software applications, including EPIC, Workday and other enterprise business and clinical systems.
- Receive, document, prioritize, assign, track, and resolve user-reported incidents and service requests.
- Troubleshoot and resolve PC-related hardware, software, operating system, peripheral, and connectivity issues.
- Install, configure, and maintain desktop and laptop software applications.
- Coordinate with Information Services personnel, vendors, and support teams to resolve escalated incidents and implement solutions.
- Ensure incidents are assigned to the appropriate support resources and actively tracked through final resolution.
- Install software upgrades, patches, revisions, fixes, and new application releases.
- Provide support for Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneDrive.
- Advise users on effective methods and best practices for utilizing software products and technology resources.
- Provide specialized support for enterprise and healthcare applications, including SHCIS, Epic, Cerner, PMTI, SBT, Workday, CARE, and other applications assigned.
- Investigate hardware issues and perform minor hardware repairs and communication connection troubleshooting.
- Develop and maintain end-user documentation for internally developed and vendor-supported applications.
- Create reference manuals, quick-reference guides, tutorials, knowledge base articles, FAQs, training materials, and online help resources.
- Ensure all documentation adheres to organizational standards and best practices.
- Plan, coordinate, develop, and conduct end-user training programs as needed.
- Deliver application-specific and productivity software training to support user adoption and organizational initiatives.
- Maintain and continuously improve knowledge management resources to support first-contact resolution and self-service capabilities.
- Assist in the evaluation, recommendation, and selection of hardware, software, communications technologies, consulting services, and system integration solutions.
- Participate in side-by-side product reviews, weighted assessments, cost-benefit analyses, and price-performance comparisons.
- Serve as a technical advisor on project teams and selection committees as assigned.
- Provide recommendations that align with organizational goals, operational needs, and technology strategies.
- Maintain and ensure the security and integrity of software libraries and related resources.
- Report security incidents and events in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
- Participate in software testing, validation, and quality assurance activities.
- Support rotating schedules and after-hours coverage requirements as needed.
- Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, Customer Support, or Technical Support environment.
- Demonstrated experience providing first-line technical support within a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
- Experience supporting enterprise business applications and end-user technologies.
- Experience with ITIL incident, request, knowledge, Major Incident Management (MIM)and change management.
- Experience with ticketing systems, and service request tracking tools.
- Experience troubleshooting Microsoft Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, desktops, laptops, and peripheral devices.
- ITIL Foundation 4 or 5 certification or must be acquired 12 months after hire.
- Microsoft Windows operating systems and MS 365 Suite
- Desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral support.
- Software installation, deployment, configuration, and maintenance.
- Basic networking concepts, VPN connectivity, and communication troubleshooting.
- Incident and problem management best practices.
- Remote support tools and technologies.
- Technical documentation and knowledge management practices.
- Enterprise application support in healthcare or large organizational environments.
- High School Diploma/GED
- Bachelor’s degree preferred in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience supporting healthcare information systems and clinical applications.
- Experience supporting Epic EHR or similar applications.
- Experience supporting Cerner, CARE, PMTI, SBT, Workday, ServiceNow or other enterprise healthcare systems.
- Experience developing user documentation and delivering end-user training.
- Leadership, mentoring, or team lead experience within a Service Desk environment.

  
Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

data.description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

**Primary Function of Position**

The Senior Market Development Manager is a market-facing commercial leader for **new indications, customer bases, markets and platforms** — operating across the full spectrum from product development through early commercialization. This role builds early go-to-market strategy, validates product market fit, ensures the commercial perspective informs upstream decisions, and builds the market infrastructure required for successful future Intuitive launches.  **This individual will focus on GI and endosurgical innovation.**

This role is deeply integrated with **engineering, product, clinical, regulatory, market access and corporate strategy teams** in both existing business units and future forward— serving as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and embedding market insight into product, clinical evidence, and market access roadmaps. Success requires equal fluency and trust in the external market and the internal development cycle.

The Senior Market Development Manager works directly with **physicians, hospital executives, payers, and societies** to identify unmet needs and shape clinical and commercial strategy. Where markets must be created rather than captured, this role is tasked with designing strategies to shift **patient pathways, referral patterns, and clinical beliefs** to unlock demand and accelerate commercial success.

**Essential Job Duties** (Specific responsibilities and tasks an individual would be expected to perform in the role. Additional job duties may be determined by functional people manager)

- Serve as market-facing commercial lead throughout the upstream development cycle; bring commercial guidance to inform strategy and optimize launch success
- Refine product market fit with market insight
- Generate deep market, customer, and clinical insights; translate into actionable product and commercial recommendations aligned with the largest unmet clinical needs
- Partner with engineering, product, clinical, and corporate strategy teams to define and execute go-to-market strategy from product development through early commercialization; serve as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and influence product roadmap and prioritization
- Identify and engage KOLs, society leadership, and key stakeholders to shape market entry, build pre-market advocacy, and market seeding priming early adoption
- Support clinical and economic evidence-building to enable market access, value articulation, and regulatory/ reimbursement strategy; support transfer into ROI and economic value models
- Understand existing commercial strategy and ways of working across Intuitive- find opportunities to leverage existing expertise to accelerate adoption in new domains.
- Develop market creation strategies where skillsets are not transferable— design approaches to change patient referral pathways, shift clinical beliefs and behaviors, and build demand in spaces where historic strategic success may be less transferable
- Originate and develop creative market entry strategies for new clinical spaces — write the playbook for indications where no established commercial model exists
- Synthesize complex inputs into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership
- Develop commercialization strategy for new indications, including salesforce structure, go-to-market model, pricing, territory design, and sales incentive plan frameworks

**Required Skills and Experience:**

- 10 years of experience in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Market Development in MedTech
- Prior leadership experience required, including direct or matrixed leadership
- Demonstrated success operating in early-stage, ambiguous, or emerging market environments
- Capacity to rapidly upskill in clinical and technical knowledge base
- Experience building and executing go to market/ market creation strategy
- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
- Experience building and leveraging KOL, society, and executive-level relationships
- Strong analytical, communication and executive presentation skills
- Ability to identify trends, distill themes, and translate customer preference to strategic priorities
- Familiarity with clinical pathways, hospital economics, capital strategy, and enterprise decision-making

**Required Education and Training:**

- Bachelor’s degree required

**Working Conditions:**

- Global travel required

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

- GI experience
- Exposure to early product development, market shaping, or pre-launch commercialization working with engineers
- Experience with surgical and/or endoscopic procedures preferred
- Strategic clinical and reimbursement experience; payer fluency
- Global or international experience

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

[Mandatory Notices](https://careers.intuitive.com/en/eeo-and-aap/)

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer:  In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on  
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.  
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the  
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target base compensation ranges are listed.

We're looking for an
**Application Support Analyst**
who enjoys solving problems, helping users, and learning how business applications work behind the scenes.
  
  
This role will support a mix of day-to-day application issues, ticket management, user administration, documentation, and project work. Applied Epic experience is helpful, but it is not required for someone who has strong application-support experience, learns quickly, and is comfortable troubleshooting unfamiliar systems.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

- Investigate and resolve functional and technical issues within enterprise business applications.
- Troubleshoot problems involving workflows, system access, user visibility, configuration, and application behavior.
- Work directly with users to understand issues, identify root causes, and determine the appropriate resolution.
- Validate system functionality after releases, configuration changes, integrations, or updates.
- Escalate more complex issues when they require deeper technical or cross-functional support.

**What We're Looking For**

- Application support experience — hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, or administering a business or enterprise application. Applied Epic is not required if the candidate has strong technical aptitude and can learn new systems quickly.
- Ticket queue management experience — experience personally managing incidents, service requests, or help desk tickets in ServiceNow or a comparable platform; understanding how to prioritize, manage SLAs, document resolutions, and balance multiple requests.
- Strong troubleshooting/problem-solving ability — able to investigate application issues, identify the cause, determine an appropriate solution, and know when escalation is necessary.
- Self-starter / learning agility — motivated, proactive, comfortable figuring things out, and able to learn unfamiliar applications without needing constant direction.
- User-facing communication skills — comfortable working directly with end users, explaining technical issues clearly, and maintaining a professional presence in a remote environment.
- Documentation discipline — able to create or update Knowledge Base articles, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and user support documentation when new issues or solutions arise.
- Ability to prioritize a high-volume workload and manage multiple requests at the same time.
- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while knowing when to ask for help or escalate an issue.
- Proactive, motivated, and willing to take initiative.

**Nice to Have**

- Hands-on Applied Epic support experience.
- ServiceNow experience.
- Application administration experience involving user setup, permissions, security/access, workgroups, or similar functions.
- Experience with minor application configuration or workflow changes.
- Experience supporting software upgrades, testing, releases, or system enhancements.
- Insurance / P&C industry experience.
- Comfortable using AI tools for productivity, problem-solving, documentation, communication, or process improvement.
- Mountain or Pacific time zone location is helpful for team coverage, but not required.

**Work Environment**

- Fully remote.
- 40/hour work week; Approximately 8:00 AM-5:00 PM based on local time zone, with some flexibility.
- U.S.-based team supporting users across the U.S. and Canada.
- Candidates in Mountain or Pacific time zones may be especially helpful for broader coverage.

**Funnel Leasing Inc.,**
is hiring for a
**Client Solutions Specialist.**
The Client Solutions Specialist serves as a strategic support advisor, partnering with key clients to architect, optimize, and govern their platform integrations and Funnel product workflows. This role exercises independent judgment to align platform capabilities with client business objectives, drive adoption of existing and new product functionality, and mitigate enterprise-level operational risks. This role is designed for individuals who can work autonomously and can combine deep platform expertise with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and professionally to client stakeholders. This role does not simply escalate — it resolves, explains, and empowers. The salary range for this role is $75,000 - $90,000 per year.
  
  
**Why Funnel?**
We are a U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!
  
  
**Who is Funnel Leasing?**
Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We've created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We're in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you'll meet.
  
  
The
**Client Solutions Specialist's**
essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
  
  
Client Engagement
  
  

- Lead strategic advisory engagements and operational reviews with client leadership to evaluate platform performance, recommend structural workflow redesigns, and drive long-term operational efficiency.
- Design and prescribe custom product workflows and governance models for key accounts
- Evaluate client business processes and independently determine strategic interventions to optimize platform ROI
- Exercise independent discretion in evaluating and resolving escalated operational roadblocks that impact client retention and business continuity
- Explain root causes of issues in plain language, connecting technical details to client business impact
- Develop and implement scalable operational frameworks, change management strategies, and best-practice standards utilized across client organizations.
- Serve as a calm, confident presence during high-friction or escalated client moments

Technical Resolution
  
  

- Diagnose complex, systemic platform integration failures and architect comprehensive mitigation strategies that safeguard key client operations and revenue continuity
- Serve as the definitive cross-functional escalation lead, exercising independent judgment to orchestrate remediation roadmaps across Product, Engineering and client-facing teams during critical operation crises
- Determine the strategic necessity of custom engineering interventions versus workflow workarounds based on enterprise business impact, risk exposure, and client lifecycle value
- Author standardized diagnostic frameworks, advanced troubleshooting methodologies, and institutional knowledge governance models utilized across global client operations teams

Team Contribution
  
  

- Design, architect, and oversee comprehensive enablement, readiness, and technical proficiency frameworks for client operations teams, establishing standardized competency models and continuous coaching methodologies to drive
- Author, govern and continuously optimize Client Operation standard operating procedures (SOPs) and service escalation policies that dictate cross-functional workflows across Support, Product, Professional Services, Consulting and Technical Success Managers
- Spearhead or collaborate on cross-functional change management initiatives and key client education programs with Professional Services, Strategy, Consulting based on Go To Market efforts
- Create a culture of continuous improvement and learning
- Foster collaboration within team and across the company
- Performs other duties as assigned and modified at manager's discretion

**Required**
**Education, Work Experience, Knowledge, and Certifications**

- Experience in enterprise SaaS operations, management consulting, or complex technical account management.
- High degree of independent judgment and accountability, with a history of evaluating business trade-offs and executing operational decisions without prescribed parameters.
- Demonstrated expertise in multi-system workflow architecture, enterprise integration governance, and mapping complex business processes to SaaS platform capabilities.
- Advanced capability to evaluate client business models, identify systemic operational friction, and independently design end-to-end workflow solutions.
- Demonstrated track record of partnering with C-suite and VP-level client executives to drive platform adoption, operational change management, and alignment with client business goals.
- Experience authoring and implementing organizational standard operating procedures (SOPs), enablement frameworks, or service escalation governance across cross-functional departments.

**Preferred**

- Experience in SaaS, proptech, or multifamily industry
- Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), Property Management System (PMS) integrations, or Internet Listing Services (ILS) workflows

This position will be responsible for executing all aspects of our Finance process and Evolution efforts at the Corporate office through thoughtful and creative innovation. This position will also help Finance in Advancing Care for our colleagues by streamlining processes and eliminating mundane tasks allowing our colleagues to spend their collective time on higher-value work, which will allow them to focus on additional analytical tasks that drive business insights and ultimately reduce Hyatt’s costs and increase hotel-level profitability and thereby increases the value of the hotels.
  
  
Duties/Responsibilities
  
  

- Translates identified business needs to technical requirements and designs, develops, deploys and supports sustainable transformative solutions such as dashboards, scorecards and various other forms of process automation.
- Performs data manipulation tasks using available and most appropriate data management tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, RPA, SAS or SQL queries and database stored procedures.
- Responsible for estimating project efforts and resources required to complete identified projects and provides periodic status updates on the progress of development.
- Schedules and participates in design working sessions with key business stakeholders.
- Collaborates with all other IT departments (i.e. Financial Systems, ServiceNow, Data & Analytics, etc.) to ensure solutions are best in class.
- Ensure Compliance with Hyatt’s change management program including:
- Responsible for moving the workflow to UAT
- First level of assistance for any UAT defects
- Updates the open defects in the defect log
- Responsible for moving the workflow to production.
- Responsible for monitoring the health of the solutions in production
- Responds to incident tickets and resolves production issues as part of ongoing support
- Stay informed evaluate new technology solutions to streamline process and drive cost reduction/avoidance
- Maintain a global focus to ensure that solutions and our knowledge base is shared with teams around the world
- Provide training and continuous monitoring during and after project completion to ensure compliance with the changed process
- Encourage and drive adoption of innovative products as well as an “Evolution Mindset” among colleagues who are hesitant to change
- Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt core values (included in all job descriptions).
- The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary (included in all job descriptions)

*All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.*
**Qualifications**
**Experience**

- 3+ years of experience with process reimaging and automation.
- Strong experience in requirement gathering and business process analysis.
- Hands-on skills and experience in Alteryx Designer, Alteryx Server, and the tools with Alteryx such as Predictive, Parsing, and Transforms a plus.
- Experience with Tableau and other RPA solutions a plus.

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree in relevant field
- Master’s degree a plus

**Computer Skills Needed To Perform This Job**

- MS Office
- Oracle, iScala, Hyperion, Blackline experience, preferred.

**Additional Comments And Requirements**

- Solid organizational skills, especially the ability to meet project deadlines with a focus on details.
- Travel to other Hyatt offices may be required (10–20%)
- Proactive nature with little supervision while managing competing priorities.
- Ability to adapt to changing priorities.
- Willingness to occasionally work off-hours as required.
- To work remotely, you must be able to adhere to our IT requirements, including, but not limited to the following: High Speed Internet service required. Broadband technologies allowed are DSL, Cable, and Fiber-Optic. All other ISP (Internet Service Provider) technologies are not allowed, including cellular based services. Colleagues will be required to provide Hyatt with adequate certification of service from provider (upon request).

**Your Opportunity**
At PLACE, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of real estate, technology, business services, and the consumer. As a profitable, hypergrowth startup, on the path to an IPO, our standards are high, our team is scrappy, and our commitment is to execute the best work of our lives.
  
  
This is YOUR CHANCE to shape the backbone of a company that's scaling rapidly and innovating boldly. As our Technical Support Specialist, you'll partner with our Support Manager, founders, and executives to serve as the front-line technical point of contact for clients and end users across the Pyramid Platform, Red Bell infrastructure, and associated application suites — resolving issues, delivering training, and driving system improvements from insight all the way through to production. If you thrive in complexity, entrepreneurial problem-solving, and believe in scaling through tech and AI, this is your PLACE.
  
  
**Who Develops You:**
Support Manager
  
  
**What You're Great At**
You're a natural troubleshooter who genuinely enjoys helping people work through a problem, whether that's over the phone, over email, or side-by-side during a training session. You've got a foundation in real estate — maybe REO, rental management, loss mitigation, acquisitions, or short sales — and you're comfortable navigating Excel and Word without a second thought. You don't just close tickets; you notice patterns in them, and you're the kind of person who turns "this keeps happening" into a real recommendation for how to fix it. You manage your time well, know when to solve something yourself and when to loop in the right person, and you communicate clearly with clients, management, and developers alike. You're self-motivated, quick to pick up new systems, and comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

- Serve as the primary technical support contact for clients, outsourcers, agents, and other end users of the Pyramid Platform and Red Bell infrastructure
- Troubleshoot and resolve inbound technical issues and inquiries received via phone and email, meeting established SLA and quality standards
- Provide onboarding and ongoing training to new and existing users on platform functionality and best practices
- Proactively analyze support ticket trends to identify recurring issues and recommend system or process optimizations that reduce future ticket volume
- Propose new features and platform enhancements based on client feedback and observed usage patterns
- Communicate directly with clients and end users to gather and clarify requirements
- Collaborate with the development team to ensure business and client requirements are accurately understood and met
- Test new features and enhancements for quality and functionality prior to release to production
- Contribute to and maintain internal and client-facing knowledge base content
- Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word
- Real estate background required
- Experience in REO, Rental Management, Loss Mitigation, Real Estate Acquisition, or Short Sales strongly preferred
- Prior experience in a technical support, help desk, or client support role preferred
- Excellent organizational, time management, and prioritization skills
- Ability to effectively communicate with management, clients, and technical staff
- Self-motivated and willing to learn new systems and skills
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, while recognizing when to escalate
- Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
- Ability to analyze recurring issues and translate findings into actionable recommendations

**Salary:**
$21-27/hour depending on experience. This is a remote role but must be able to work from 8:00am to 5:00pm MST for core hours.
  
  
**Why PLACE**
We believe people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and surrounded by others who are equally driven. That's why this role includes a "work from the PLACE you work best" approach – at home, in an office, or on the move. Our competitive benefits include PTO as needed, comprehensive insurance coverage, a 401(k) match, stock option grants, and a stock purchase plan. Every team member is an owner, building the "PLACE" they are proud to call "my company."

company_object.long_description:
PLACE is an end-to-end technology and business services platform designed to simplify the real estate lifecycle for both consumers and their real estate agents. We partner exclusively with leading real estate teams, regardless of brokerage, in 100+ locations across the United States and Canada. Some of the nation’s top producing real estate teams choose to partner with PLACE because, unlike many of the other tech companies in our industry, we feel cutting-edge proptech should support the hardest working agents instead of eliminating them. 

At the forefront of our business is a consumer services model that takes the guesswork out of real estate. Clients of PLACE-powered agents will have access to a one-stop shop that streamlines the traditionally complicated process of buying, selling, maintaining, and investing in properties. Our upcoming products include in-house mortgage brokers, title and escrow services, an insurance portal, and a home improvement network referral system, among other exciting initiatives. 

In addition, PLACE’s proprietary technology and business services platform helps agents offload up to 75% of their operations tasks so they can focus on being a key advisor to their clients. PLACE partners value relationships over transactions because we take care of team accounting, bookkeeping, human resources, in-house legal, design and marketing, videography, talent acquisition, business training and coaching. Agents within PLACE-powered teams have access to employee-like benefits that are notoriously unavailable to Realtors, even at the highest production levels. 

Our industry is changing and we want to bring the best candidates along for the ride. We are actively recruiting for new PLACE partners, open positions within our headquarters team, and on behalf of existing PLACE partners across the US. If you want to contribute to changing the real estate transaction and homeownership process for the better, join us today.

As the **Associate Product Consultant,**you are the “Voice of Moen” that consumers interact with when they have product, installation, or warranty questions. You will provide world-class customer service to our consumers and receive over 200 hours of paid virtual training in Moen products to ensure you are ready to assist our customers.

Before the completion of training and to ensure you are ready for the role, you will be paired with a tenured teammate to prepare for success in your new career.

Moen offers a competitive **starting rate of $17/hour with the possibility of overtime** and **benefits from day one,** which include medical, dental, vision, monthly and annual bonus opportunities, paid time off, 401K, profit sharing, product discounts, and more.

**This position is 100% remote, and Moen provides all the necessary equipment for you to be successful!**

If this sounds like the position for you, **our next training will begin November 2, 2026,** with training hours of 9:00 am-5:30 pm EST.  After completion of training,the working hours will be8-hour shifts beginning **8:00 am- 10:30 am EST** (or the equivalent for your time zone) **Monday through Friday.**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Be the trusted resource customers turn to for troubleshooting, warranty questions, installation support, and product concerns.
- Get to the root of the problem: gather the details, diagnose the issue, and guide customers through a clear, step-by-step fix.
- Own the warranty decision — the right outcome, replacement, or next step, guided by Moen’s standards.
- Work across multiple systems and knowledge bases to find answers and document every interaction so nothing slips through.
- Deliver a genuinely helpful experience on every contact — clear, accurate, and human.
- Grow your product knowledge and sharpen your troubleshooting so customers get better answers over time.

- Time in high-volume, metric-driven environments.
- A knack for de-escalation and service recovery, and familiarity with CRM systems or knowledge bases.
